text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 7, 2024) for 3 Elm Grove Avenue

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 7, 2024) for 3 Elm Grove Avenue, Folder Number 24 191840 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 2, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
